info.name: Kaapi Standalone Guardrails
info.description:
Run Kaapi guardrails on any text with `POST /api/v1/guardrails`, then fetch the result with `GET /api/v1/guardrails/{job_id}`.

**Setup:** set the collection variables `base_url` (e.g. `http://localhost:8000`) and `API_KEY` (the full value, e.g. `ApiKey abc…`).

Every submit request stores `job_id`, so run **Get result** right after it. Each `config` entry is either an inline spec (`{"type": "pii_remover", ...}`) or a stored config (`{"validator_config_id": "..."}`). Full guide: `docs/guardrails/standalone-guardrails.md`.

item.name: 5. Other validator types (stored config only)
item.description: Seven types the guardrails service supports but Kaapi doesn't offer inline. Each pair is: create a stored config, then run it. Run each pair in order: the create request overwrites `validator_config_id`. `topic_relevance`, `llm_critic` and `answer_relevance_custom_llm` need a working OpenAI key on the guardrails service; `llamaguard_7b` needs the Guardrails Hub validator installed.
